Project.NAME: YiCamAlt
Project.keywords: yi-camera, android, rtsp, streaming, alternative-client, camera, protocol-reverse-engineering, live-view
Project.annotation: Альтернативный Android-клиент для камер Yi Home / Yi Dome с открытой архитектурой, обходящий ограничения платной подписки. Приложение обеспечивает live-view, просмотр архива событий, управление камерой и работу с облачными/локальными хранилищами.

M-CONFIG.NAME: Config
M-CONFIG.purpose: Central application configuration: feature flags, API base URLs, build variants, and runtime settings.

fn-getApiBaseUrl.PURPOSE: Return base URL for Yi Cloud API (prefers user override, else BuildConfig)

fn-setApiBaseUrl.PURPOSE: Persist a runtime API base URL override

fn-setManualBaseUrl.PURPOSE: Store a server typed by the user and pin it; blank returns to automatic selection

type-YiRegion.PURPOSE: Yi Cloud gateways US, EU, SG (default order); fromBaseUrl, orderStartingWith; app/src/main/java/com/yicamalt/config/YiRegion.kt

contract-RegionSelector.PURPOSE: Region port (currentRegion, selectRegion, currentBaseUrl, restoreBaseUrl); implemented by ConfigModule, consumed by M-AUTH

fn-isLocalRtspEnabled.PURPOSE: Check if local RTSP is allowed by config

fn-flag.PURPOSE: Look up a single flag by name; throws MissingKey if absent

M-CONFIG.change-summary: ConfigModule implemented: reads BuildConfig once at construction, exposes typed accessors + feature flags. ConfigError.MissingKey. Runtime API base URL override via SettingsStore (PrefsSettingsStore + InMemorySettingsStore) so the app can point at a real Yi Cloud endpoint; setApiBaseUrl persists the override. Phase-1 gate green (39 tests).

YiRegion (US, EU, SG; declaration order = default order) + RegionSelector port implemented by ConfigModule (bindRegionSelector, BLOCK_SELECT_REGION logs the region name only). Real default gateway https://gw-us.xiaoyi.com/ replaces the placeholder host; api.xiaoyi.com only as a manual server; manual-server flag disables every automatic region change. ConfigModuleTest 13 tests.

M-HTTP.purpose: Shared HTTP client (OkHttp + Retrofit2) with TLS config, auth interceptor, error mapping, and retry policy.

fn-probeClient.PURPOSE: Client without auth interceptor, Authenticator.NONE, no redirects (M-DEBUG-PROBE only)

class-YiRequestSigner.PURPOSE: Single HMAC-SHA1 signer: signingKey, canonicalMessage (seq, userid, extra params), hmacSha1Base64, sign

class-LogRedactor.PURPOSE: maskQuery for secret-key query values; maskJsonBody shape-only allowlist body masking

class-YiAppHeaders.PURPOSE: Official Yi Home 6.9.8 headers on device/deviceshare/tnp paths, never on /v4/users login

M-HTTP.change-summary: HttpClientModule implemented: OkHttp+Retrofit, auth interceptor, redacted logging (redactHeader), single-refresh 401 authenticator. AuthProvider contract introduced. Retrofit made rebuildable via rebuild() so a runtime base URL change takes effect. Phase-1 gate green (39 tests).

GSD phase 01 (plans 01-01, 01-04, 01-05): LogRedactor (maskQuery, maskJsonBody; logger at BASIC), YiRequestSigner (single signer, EventSigner and inline CameraRegistry copy removed), YiAppHeaders, Retrofit on placeholder https://yi-api.invalid/ with base URL resolved per request (BLOCK_RESOLVE_BASE_URL), probeClient. Full suite 165 tests green.

GSD phase 01 (plan 01-02): CameraDao BLOCK_DB_WRITE logs no identifiers (online=, hasModel= only); YiDatabaseTest scenario_5 proves a 13-digit serial never appears. Diagnostic log moved to internal filesDir/diag_log.txt with 1 MiB rotation (SEC-02).

M-AUTH.NAME: Authentication
M-AUTH.purpose: Handle Yi Cloud authentication: login, token refresh, session management, secure token storage.

fn-login.PURPOSE: Authenticate with Yi Cloud and store tokens

fn-refreshToken.PURPOSE: Refresh access token using refresh token

fn-getAccessToken.PURPOSE: Return current valid access token (refreshes on expiry)

fn-isLoggedIn.PURPOSE: Check if user has valid session

fn-refresh.PURPOSE: Refresh access token using refresh token; returns null on failure

contract-LoginPort.PURPOSE: Thin login contract consumed by M-UI-LOGIN; implemented by AuthRepository

contract-DeviceListCheckPort.PURPOSE: One signed GET /v5/devices/list reduced to code + count for the login region discovery; HttpDeviceListCheck in app/src/main/java/com/yicamalt/auth/RegionDiscovery.kt

contract-LogoutCleanup.PURPOSE: Port called synchronously by logout(); implemented by CameraRegistry (camera cache + P2P store wipe), injected through a Provider to avoid a DI cycle

M-AUTH.change-summary: AuthRepository implemented: login/refresh/logout/getSession, implements AuthProvider + LoginPort. EncryptedAuthStore (EncryptedSharedPreferences). YiCloudAuthApi (Retrofit). Hilt bindings. Login endpoint corrected to real Yi Cloud surface: GET /v4/users/login (query params seq/account/password/dev_name/dev_type/dev_os_version) + POST /v4/users/auth_token for refresh; response code deserialized as String; missing access_token -> InvalidCredentials. Test written (MockWebServer), deferred (no Android SDK).

v0.3.1 audit fix: reverted unfounded 'login' query-param rename back to 'account' — live probes of gw-us/eu/sg.xiaoyi.com/v4/users/login decoded the error ladder (unrecognized account param -> 20250; account without password -> 20260; account+password -> 20253; GET no-params -> 20203; POST no-body -> -10003). Failure log now carries the server message.

v0.4.2 VERIFIED ON DEVICE (2026-09-09): real login works end-to-end — GET /v4/users/login with account + HMAC-SHA256 password -> code 20000 -> token/token_secret/userid -> EncryptedSharedPreferences -> HomeScreen «Вход выполнен» (user id redacted). Fix chain: account param (not login), HMAC password digest, token_secret as refresh key, DEFAULT_EXPIRES_SECONDS when expires_in absent, authInterceptor bypass for auth_token calls, post-login HomeScreen navigation.

Bounded login region selection (CAM-02): hop on code 20253 (BLOCK_REGION_FALLBACK), then region discovery by device list (BLOCK_REGION_DISCOVERY, DeviceListCheckPort) keeping the first region with a non-empty /v5/devices/list, else the first successful login (BLOCK_REGION_SELECTED). At most 3 logins + 3 list checks per press, no retries, never on refresh or start; manual server = 1 login, 0 checks. AuthRepositoryTest 23 + AuthRegionDiscoveryTest 18.
SEC-04 fail-closed logout: logout() clears the session and runs LogoutCleanup synchronously (BLOCK_LOGOUT_CLEANUP cleared=true or code=LOGOUT_CLEANUP_FAILED); a cancelled caller cannot skip the wipe.

fn-cacheCameraList.PURPOSE: Persist camera list to local DB

On-device verification pending (plan 01-11 Task 2/3).

2026-10-16 Phase 2 review MED-4: CameraRegistry v0.8.0 refreshCredentials (one getCameraList, errors swallowed, BLOCK_REFRESH_CREDENTIALS result=<ok|ErrorClass> found=<b>) for the live probe's single WRONG_PASSWORD retry. CameraRegistryCredentialsTest creds_13.

M-EVENT.change-summary: 2026-09-28 implemented. Endpoints are PROVISIONAL (EventPaths constants): development-plan note-1 records GET /v1/camera/event/list, but the reverse-engineering in PROJECT_STATUS.md showed real Yi Cloud paths are versioned without a /v1 prefix, so the path is a guess pending a capture.
